subject: rt-algn
title: RT.ALGN.------CULT.INFO.DY.
description: Diagram in The New York Movement section (NYM-11) condensing the structural argument running across pages 374–379 of TAW1: the reality alignment (RT-ALGN) of post-Ayler creative black music is not autonomously self-determined but is *crossed* — the (c) prefix denotes a crossing relation — with culture information dynamics (CULT-INFO-DY), the apparatus by which the white defining/controlling community processes and disseminates cultural product. The crossing is mediated, not direct: a determined chain runs from information dissemination (INFO-DS) through political policies (POL-P), redocumentation (RE-DOC), affinity compression (AF-COMP), and controlled information (CN-INFO) into political dynamics (POL-DYM) and from there onto RT-ALGN itself. Isolated focus (IST-F) and a transformation/transition node (the diagram-only term TR-TRS, fed by social reality particulars SOC-RT-P) bear directly on the subject; alternative functionalism (ALT-F) bears on CULT-INFO-DY in turn. The page's prose makes the diagram concrete: rock music's commercial dominance was crushing post-Ayler musicians economically, but Braxton's claim is structural rather than circumstantial — black creative music's reality options are constrained by the cultural-political control chain, which 'defines and discards' (NYM-12) the music through redocumentation and dissemination policy rather than through any direct engagement with the music's own thrust trajectory.
